data.gender_notes: Fayaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fayaz is a name of Arabic, Urdu, Pashto, and Persian origin that means 'maker' or 'creator'. It is a name of great significance in Islamic culture, as it reflects the belief in the power of Allah as the ultimate creator of all things. The name Fayaz carries the meaning “Maker, Creator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Fayaz usually hope their child will grow to embody maker, creator and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayaz total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: فیاز

in_hindi.name: फयाज
